claims: Exact GA102 headers name BCR_CTRL core select at +0x668 bit 4, Falcon CPUCTL at +0x100 bit 4 HALTED, and RISC-V CPUCTL at +0x388 bit 4 HALTED.
Envytools names application 1 PRE_OS and target 1 PMU, and exposes the twelve legacy descriptor fields. The copied ROM record and BIT pointer independently resolve to the same descriptor.
NVIDIA FWSEC parser says legacy v1 is unused by that GSP-RM parser; this does not mean every VBIOS component uses the FWSEC v3 format.

Nouveau corroborates the PMU base and PRE_OS application convention on its older path, but the pinned GA102 chip table does not instantiate a PMU subdevice. Its GM200 path is not asserted as a GA102 recovery backend.
unresolved: Actual physical mapping of the PRE_OS D[0x140...] operands to GPU PRI, and host accessibility/privilege.
Installed-byte identity, production/debug equivalence, current core selection and HALTED status.
Whether the failed boot reached this branch. The retained GSP halt-success/progress-1 result is not evidence of an ongoing nested PMU wait.
Physical meanings and runtime modification of the 16 differing PRE_OS data bytes.
